newsitem.title: UK: UK car production up 5.4 pct in 6 mths to March.
newsitem.headline: UK car production up 5.4 pct in 6 mths to March.

text.p: Total UK production of cars rose by 5.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the six months ending March 1997 compared to the previous six months, the Office for National Statistics said on Friday.
Production allocated for the home market rose by 8.3 percent in the period and export production rose by 3.1 percent.

Compared to the same period a year ago, total car production, seasonally adjusted, increased by 13.4 per cent. Production allocated for export rose by 27.3 per cent and home production rose by 0.1 per cent.

Total commercial vehicle production, seasonally adjusted, for the six months ending March 1997 was 2.6 percent up on the previous six months and 14.8 percent up on the corresponding period a year ago.
